description: Get All Folders - Retrieve all folders. The type filter supports 'all', 'general', and 'email-sender'. General folders (created without a type) hold lists, templates, and sequences; email-sender folders hold email senders only.

limit.description: Maximum number of folders to return (default: 100)

skip.description: Number of folders to skip for pagination (default: 0)

type.description: Folder type filter. 'all' returns every folder (default), 'general' returns non-email-sender folders, 'email-sender' returns email-sender folders only.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: get_all_folders

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Get All Folders
